Sam — thanks, that all makes sense. Answers inline and small update to the MAP: 

- CIDR: for the staging pool we recommend these egress IPs: 34.210.112.0/24, 52.24.160.0/24, 18.197.40.0/24 (these are for the staging host egress). If you need a single CIDR umbrella we can request a NAT gateway allocation but the three /24s are what our peering infra advertises today.
- BGP: not required for the POC. We support standard AWS VPC peering with static routes. No BGP setup necessary.
- Maintenance window: Thu 2027-05-20, 11:00–13:00 ET works for our network team.
